hooks.text: 多种职业以不同初始物品和强项开局，直接改变角色起步方案。
hooks.excerpt: Pick Your Class! You can play many Classes, each with different starting Items and strengths
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 世界与地下城每次游玩都会变化，让关卡遭遇无法按固定路线重复。
hooks.excerpt: The world and dungeons changes each time you play. So none of the gameplay will be the same!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 支持二至四人组队合作，把职业和构筑带入多人地下冒险。
hooks.excerpt: Gather a team of 2-4 players and enjoy Multiplayer CO-OP experienc
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 闪避操作笨拙且手感差。

excerpts.excerpt: much more clunky, dodge feels bad
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 强度曲线在早期暴毙与后期碾压之间失衡。

excerpts.excerpt: It's either you die in two first levels or transcend into godhood and steamroll till end.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 几乎所有敌人都会发射高速远程弹道，设计令人反感。

excerpts.excerpt: every single enemy shoot fast projectiles that have nearly infinite range is super dumb
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 部分成就和角色解锁存在Bug。

excerpts.excerpt: Some achievements and character unlocks are straight up bugged.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 满背包时拾取物品会导致物品永久无法再拾取。

excerpts.excerpt: If you try to pick up items with full inventory, the item will be permanently be unable to be picked up
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 短时间砍杀敌人的过程很有趣。

excerpts.excerpt: slashing enemies in short sessions is fun
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 提炼了该类型最基础且有趣的核心。

excerpts.excerpt: distill a genre down to the simple components that make it fun
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 发现新构筑非常令人满足。

excerpts.excerpt: discovering new builds is incredibly satisfying
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段
